tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITION AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidders should have provided similar services to provide manpower to Government Departments or Govt Authorities or Local bodies or Govt PSUs or to private companies continuously for at least one year during the last three financial years. Performance certificate from these organizations shall be furnished. Provided that in case of experience to provide personal as manpower agency to private companies.
The bidder should be a registered Agency/firm/Company with P.F ESI, IT, service Tax and with contract licenses (as applicable) etc from Labour department/ISO 9001/2008 Certificate
The Private Company must be registered/incorporated under the Indian Companies Act 1956/partnership Act 1932.
Bank Solvency Certificate for Rs.10 Lakhs issued by the Nationalized Bank (Copy to be enclosed).
Details of the Registration with Labour Department for having at least 300 personnel copy to be submitted in Form C only.

The bidders should not be a defaulter or a black listed firm in respect of any tender or contract in any of the Government departments/authorities/PSUs or companies (see clause The bidder should be furnished Rs.100 non judicial stamp paper certified by the notary to be submitted stating that the entity has not been black listed by any Government and non Governmental departments
The relevant supporting documents in respect of the eligibility criteria for the above items should be uploaded along with the tender documents without which the tender is liable for rejection.
ALL OTHER TECHNICAL CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

The bidder shall have the financial annual turnover in at least one financial year in the preceding three financial years 2024-25 2025-26 or 2026-27 two times the bid value given in the above. The audited balance-sheet certified by a Chartered Accountant shall be submitted as a proof of the turn-over
